goal: Launch first GameWinners listing on Etsy
result: Built generation pipeline, order system, admin dashboard. Listings not yet live.
human_view: We spent too long on architecture. Time to ship something and learn from real customers.

lesson: The meta-path (knowledge asset) is more valuable than any single product. Every session should be captured.
